panel.searchDescription: Search for and closely read key papers to answer a specific research question with full-text evidence and citations.
panel.searchPrompt: Are large language models more likely to miss information in the middle of long documents? Find relevant papers, download and read the key full texts, and answer based on experimental results.
panel.analysisDescription: Compare methods, conditions, and conclusions using original sources
panel.analysisPrompt: Compare the methods, applicability, and limitations of two low-elevation measurement papers in this project.
panel.reviewDescription: Select important papers, read them closely, and deliver a fully cited literature review.
panel.reviewPrompt: Write a literature review on AI agents in research workflows: find and closely read important papers from the past three years, organize the field by research direction, and produce a structured review with a comparison table of representative work, open questions, and a complete reference list.
panel.ideasDescription: Start from a research direction and produce evidence-grounded ideas with a basic research plan.
panel.ideasPrompt: Generate literature-grounded research ideas about long-term memory for large language models, explain the core hypothesis and differences from prior work, and form a basic research plan covering key experiments and major risks.
